inputs.text: [excited] Thirty-three feet long — [amazed] as long as a truck. Standing up, eight feet tall — [curious] as tall as a soccer goal. And three thousand kilos — [proud] as heavy as a hippo.
[curious] And how big were the spikes?
[confident] Up to two feet tall — [amazed] right in the MIDDLE of its neck. The tallest of any known sauropod.
